desc: Fast blur wipe. Comic timing, or a hard location change.
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04 between two real clips, AND THE DESCRIPTION DOES NOT MATCH THE FILTER. The card says 'fast blur wipe'; the filter is xfade=hlslice, which produces a hard-edged sliced band wipe with no blur of any kind - visible in the strip as interleaved bands of the two shots. It is the fastest wipe here at 8 frames. Its nearest neighbour is wipe_l at MAD 5.31, the closest non-identical pair in the library: the two differ mainly in duration (8 vs 12 frames), not in character. If a blur is wanted it has to come from somewhere other than this filter.
consumer_gap: THIS FILTER IS CORRECT AND NO FILM RENDERS IT. scripts/short.py concats micro-shots and has no xfade join path, so it never reads `filter`. scripts/epic.py has its own hardcoded five-name table (cut/soft/dissolve/fade/flash) keyed off shot['in'], while compile.py writes beat['transition'] - different key, different vocabulary - and epic.py never opens studio/transitions/*.json. The sample clip is real because the sample generator applies this filter directly. Six proven filters, zero films that can use them. Out of scope for the 2026-08-04 wave; flagged here so the card stops implying otherwise.
